title: Pet Hair and Daily Care: Four Picks for Dogs and Cats
description: Four everyday pet care picks: a self-cleaning brush, a reusable hair roller, a stainless steel water fountain and a dog dental water additive.
dek: Brush it, roll it, refill it. Four small routines that make daily pet care easier.
constraint: Dog and cat owners, each under $30
hook: Most daily pet care comes down to hair, water and teeth. These four picks each cover one of those jobs.
I did not test these. I read each listing and use only what it says, so check the details on the page before you buy.
skipped: Anything where the listing does not say what the item is or what size it is.
Anything that needs tools, wiring or a permanent change, for the renter and small-space guides.
how_picked: Each pick is under the price bracket shown.
The listing says what the item is and its size or capacity.
The listing gives a check or limit worth knowing before you buy.
Specs come from the listing text. Review counts and star ratings are not used here.
final: If the sofa is the problem, start with the roller. If your pet drinks little, try the fountain, and add the brush if you are seeing hair everywhere.
hero_alt: A sunlit kitchen corner with a stainless steel pet water fountain and a golden retriever resting on a rug

picks.name: Hertzko Self-Cleaning Slicker Brush for Dogs & Cats
picks.alt: Illustration of a slicker brush with a retract button beside a dog
picks.best_for: Brushing out loose hair on a dog or cat
picks.limit: Check the size and coat type on the listing
picks.why: A slicker brush with a button that retracts the bristles to release the hair it collected, so clearing the brush takes a second.
picks.con: The listing covers sizes and coat types. Pick the size that fits your pet and check the coat type before buying.

picks.name: ChomChom Roller Pet Hair Remover, Reusable, No Batteries
picks.alt: Illustration of a reusable pet hair roller on a sofa
picks.best_for: Pet hair on sofas, rugs and bedding
picks.why: Roll it one direction over a sofa or rug and hair collects in a chamber you empty. There are no batteries, tape sheets or refills, and it works on dog and cat hair.
picks.con: It collects hair into a chamber, so empty it often. Follow the direction on the listing.

picks.name: Veken 95oz Stainless Steel Pet Water Fountain
picks.alt: Illustration of a stainless steel pet water fountain on a kitchen floor
picks.best_for: Pets that ignore a still water bowl
picks.limit: Needs filter and pump cleaning on a schedule
picks.why: A circulating fountain with a 95 oz tank, made of stainless steel, that encourages drinking.
picks.con: Clean the filter and the pump on schedule, as the listing says. Expect to do it regularly.

picks.name: Arm & Hammer Complete Care Dog Dental Water Additive, 16 fl oz
picks.alt: Illustration of a bottle of dental water additive next to a dog bowl
picks.best_for: Adding to a dog's routine alongside brushing
picks.limit: Does not replace brushing or a vet check
picks.why: A 16 fl oz additive that goes in the water bowl. It is marketed as odorless and flavorless and supports a dental routine.
picks.con: It supports a dental routine and does not replace brushing or a vet check. It is for dogs.
